components.name: Primary Workbench Button
components.description: Compact operational action used near export/import/workbench actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 38px; border: 1px solid #0b7f77; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 13px; color: #fff; background: #0b7f77; font: 750 .78rem 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #075f59; border-color: #075f59; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(117,217,208,.38); outline-offset: 2px; }
components.overview: Current visual authority is a calm technical console: dark abyss hero, pale paper workbench, teal engineering accents, monospace metadata, tabular numbers, collapsible panels, and real hull visualization rather than decorative pseudo-CAD imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Product-first engineering workbench with restrained public hero.
Real visualization and coordinate proof over marketing decoration.
Light operational surfaces with dark marine framing.
Native controls and explicit labels instead of custom faux-CAD widgets.

rules.name: The Scarce Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal lime is a hero emphasis color, not a general success token.

rules.name: The Tabular Trust Rule
rules.body: Engineering values should keep tabular-number treatment and units close to the value.

dos: Preserve the real 3D hero render as proof, or replace it only with another real product-derived render.
Keep Body/SNAME-NED coordinate clarity visible near controls, 3D sections, and equipment placement.
Keep equipment-only balance clearly marked as not full hydrostatics.
donts: Do not turn the product into a generic SaaS dashboard.
Do not introduce glassmorphism, nested-card clutter, or decorative pseudo-CAD controls.
Do not imply full CAD/CAE, full hydrostatics, or validated production analysis.
